title: This ancient rock shelter in Spain preserves the story of how people moved from hunting to farming around 8,000 years ago
description: A rock shelter in northeastern Spain is giving archaeologists a rare and clear look at one of the biggest changes in human history, the shift from hunting and gathering to farming. The site, called Coves del Fem, sits above the Montsant River in Catalonia and has been dug up since...

title: Young Spiritual Leader Swami Shreeyoga Launches Shree Padma Mangal Foundation to Promote Ancient Indian Wisdom and Conscious Living
description: Ahmedabad (Gujarat) [India], July 27: Since increasing awareness of mental well-being, conscious living and holistic personal development is leading more people to look into traditional knowledge systems, the young spiritual figure Swami Shreeyoga has established the Shree Padma Mangal Foundation, a non-profit organisation aimed at promoting spirituality, youth empowerment, education and humanitarian service by putting ancient Indian wisdom into practice.
